title: Thermal Feedback in the High-mass Star- and Cluster-forming Region W51
question: Do forming high-mass protostars heat large volumes of surrounding gas (inhibiting fragmentation) while the main-sequence stars that power compact H II regions do not, and are the protostars on the main sequence while accreting?

data.arrays: 12m array (two configurations) 37-pointing mosaic plus 7m array 12-pointing mosaic
data.angular_resolution: 0.2 arcsec (12m continuum); 0.33 arcsec for most line data
data.sensitivity: continuum ~0.2 mJy/beam lowest noise, up to ~2 mJy/beam near e2 and IRS2

what.value: Herschel Hi-GAL SED dust temperatures (38 K or 26 K)

evidence.quote: is 38 K when including the 70 $\mu \textrm{m}$ data or 26 K when excluding it.

what.value: cm continuum limits for e2e (<0.6 mJy/beam at 14.5 GHz)

evidence.quote: $S_{14.5 GHz} < 0.6$ mJy/beam (2-$\sigma$) in a FWHM=$0.34\arcsec$ beam

what.value: dust opacity extrapolation, kappa(227 GHz)=0.0083 cm2/g, beta=1.75

evidence.quote: using the extrapolation of (cite: Ossenkopf1994a) opacity from (cite: Aguirre2011a) with $\beta=1.75$

recipe.method: astrodendro dendrogram on continuum, filtered by S/N from local residual RMS map; plus by-eye ds9 catalog
key_parameters: removed sources with peak S/N<8, mean S/N<5, min S/N<1; leaves only

recipe.goal: Brightness-temperature luminosity and dust mass limits for hot cores
recipe.method: peak T_B as lower limit on temperature; blackbody L; optically thick minimum mass per beam

recipe.goal: CH3OH LTE rotational diagram temperatures and columns
recipe.method: per-pixel rotational diagrams of moment-0 maps of 8 CH3OH lines, E/A=1
key_parameters: moment range 51-60 km/s; continuum median over 25-35, 85-95 km/s

recipe.goal: Radial mass profiles and Jeans analysis
recipe.method: enclosed mass vs radius with T_dust=T_CH3OH or 40 K; thermal Jeans mass and length
assumptions: T_dust=40 K upper-mass case; 600 K lower bound

recipe.method: moment 1/2 maps and position-velocity diagrams perpendicular to outflow (PA=35 deg for e2e)
Stromgren sphere Q_lyc from cm T_B upper limit via Condon/Mezger relations; compare with tabulated B-star Q
assumptions: alpha_B=3e-13 cm3/s; Te=8500 K; optically thin H II region

evidence.quote: the peak flux density toward W51 e2e is 0.38 Jy, which corresponds to a brightness temperature $T_B=225$ K.

answer_key.quantity: Minimum optically thick mass per beam

evidence.quote: the minimum mass per beam to achieve $\tau\geq1$ is $M=18$ $M_{\odot}$ beam$^{-1}$.

answer_key.quantity: ALMA flux recovery fraction vs BGPS

not_stated_but_needed: Robust value and clean parameters (scales, mask) for the main continuum image
Exact line-free channel list for continuum
Rotational diagram fitting details (pixel selection, S/N cuts)
missing_for_reproduction: Exact tclean parameters for main continuum image
score_reason: Public data, released scripts and mostly numeric steps; some imaging parameters need scripts.
rediscovery_reason: Public data and scripts, quantitative results (T_B, luminosity, recovery fraction, catalog size) can be redone.
